race.comment: TORO STRIKE (9) is in red-hot touch and doesn't look to be slowing down. Gets significant weight relief with the rise in grade and keeps Benny Thompson. Can surge on. NAILS MURPHY (4) is a tricky one to catch but there's no doubting his ability on his day. Was back to somewhere near his best last time and with the claimer sticking he can give this a big shake, though the wide draw is testing. ATMOSPHERE (1) is in career-best touch and is sure to give another bold look from the favourable draw. Will not hesitate stealing it from the front. MISS MARANDA (11) is knocking on the door and rates a lightweight flying late chance if the pace is genuine. AKKADIAN EMPEROR (6) is perhaps looking for further but shoulders peaks that measures up, so respecting in the minors.
